task_instance: Build a minimal local web app (a counter with an Increment button) served on http://127.0.0.1:3000, then use Playwright (standing in for the skill's persistent js_repl session) to launch a real Chromium browser, navigate to it, run functional QA (assert initial state, click the button 3 times via real input, assert the count/status text updates, reload and confirm reset), a viewport-fit check, and visual QA (before/after JPEG screenshots), then clean up the browser/session.
blocker_detail: The skill's own prerequisite tool, `js_repl` (a Codex CLI feature), does not exist in this runtime, so the workflow was reproduced with plain Node.js + the Playwright library invoked via Bash instead of a literal js_repl REPL cell-by-cell session -- this is a substitution of interface, not a capability gap, since the runtime does grant browser automation and script execution. One real obstacle was hit and worked around: `npx playwright install chromium` failed because the egress proxy returns 403 for cdn.playwright.dev (org policy denial). Worked around by discovering a pre-provisioned real Chromium build already on disk at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome and pointing Playwright's chromium.launch at it via executablePath, which worked correctly.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec/openai__skills__playwright-interactive . Set up: npm init -y; npm install playwright (playwright import verified with the skill's own one-liner: 'playwright import ok'). Sample app: app/index.html (counter + Increment button). Dev server: `npx http-server ./app -p 3000 -a 127.0.0.1` run in background, verified listening with curl. QA script qa.js launched real Chromium (executablePath /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome, --no-sandbox, headless for this container) and ran: page.goto -> title 'Counter Demo'; viewport-fit check (innerWidth 1600, innerHeight 900, no horizontal/vertical scroll -> canScrollX/Y false); functional QA asserted initial count '0', clicked #incBtn 3 times, asserted count became '3' and status text 'clicked 3 time(s)'; reload() confirmed renderer reload path resets state to '0'; captured screenshot-before.jpg and screenshot-after.jpg (scale:'css', jpeg quality 85). Ran `node qa.js` -> output: 'Loaded: Counter Demo', viewport fit object logged, 'After 3 clicks -> count: 3 | status: clicked 3 time(s)', 'Reload reset count to: 0', 'QA session closed. All checks passed.' with exit code 0 (no assertion failures). Visually reviewed screenshot-after.jpg (via Read tool image render) and confirmed it shows count=3 and 'clicked 3 time(s)' with clean, unclipped layout, matching the functional assertions -- i.e. functional QA and visual QA were cross-verified as the skill's Signoff checklist requires. Cleaned up by killing the http-server process (curl to :3000 afterward hung/refused, confirming shutdown).
